_about: Public-domain William Chillingworth (1602-1644), Laudian divine and champion of reason in religion, for the Word Hoard: The Religion of Protestants a Safe Way to Salvation in its first edition (Oxford, 1638) and Bohn's edition (1846), and his Works (Oxford: University Press, 1838, three volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
